#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""vaultctl - client for vaultd (localhost:31337). Reads the passphrase from config.ini."""

    f = s.makefile("rw")

import socket, base64

data = base64.b64decode(open("/home/agent/ctf/vault.bin","rb").read().splitlines()[1])
data = data[::-1]
pt = bytes(b ^ key[i % len(key)] for i, b in enumerate(data))

EOF
